cues: The old man is never identified: angel, castaway, or a Norwegian with wings.
He is human in every detail, smelly, sick and old, and endlessly patient, and in the end he leaves on his own terms.
Pelayo and Elisenda are neither heroes nor villains: too kind to kill him, scared enough to cage him, quick to make money.
Father Gonzaga is the slow, sceptical Church.
And the crowd is curious, greedy, cruel, and fickle.
